summary: One medium omission: the map misses the explicit, still-unresolved Golay/Construction-A input to the current moonshine blueprint’s Leech-lattice gap. Its ten existing links, three overlaps and five requests survive the checked attacks; all ten edges and prerequisite entries are present in the actual production assembler. The proposed correction records a pending owner handoff, without pretending that binary Construction A supplies a rootless lattice.

Full check_links on the original accepted packet reports 0 errors and 0 warnings. Red-team result checker, intake validation on both assigned files, and whitespace checks pass. No Lean file required or compiled; no Lake project, library build or language server started.

findings.claim: The complete map records that moonshine has no stated code-stage input, but the current QM.6 blueprint gap explicitly names AlgebraicCodingTheory Layers 5–6 (Golay and Construction A) as inputs to its unresolved Leech-lattice construction. No overlap/request records this planned consumer and the missing intermediate lattice owner. The omission is a scope handoff, not evidence that the existing ten arrows are wrong or that an unconditional Construction-A-to-Leech edge should be installed.
findings.evidence: At repository revision d3cbee6e139d5836e3374bf4ef440ce17074fe78, the focal examined entry says: “Theta/partition and moonshine applications do not state a code-stage input; the coding roadmap excludes theta-series development.” In research/blueprint/packets/QSeriesPartitionsAndMockModularForms.json, gaps[title="The Frenkel–Lepowsky–Meurman moonshine module V♮ and its Monster action"], the stated construction needs “the Leech lattice (no roadmap of the atlas constructs it; AlgebraicCodingTheory Layers 5–6 supply the Golay code and Construction A)”. This gap names QM.6/monster-head-characters and QM.6/monstrous-moonshine-theorem as consumers and is rendered in research/blueprint/readmes/QSeriesPartitionsAndMockModularForms.md, line3823. The packet is partial and unreviewed: this is explicit planned use, not a promoted theorem. The coding README Layers 5–6 supplies the displayed Golay code and integral rational Construction A but expressly excludes rank-24 classification. Independently, 2e_i is in P_2(C) for every binary code and has B_2-norm2, so P_2(G24) itself cannot discharge a rootless Leech-lattice contract. Shimada, arXiv:2311.18309v1, §§2.1 and3 (printed pp.2,4), defines roots by absolute square-norm2 and the Leech lattice as the rootless Niemeier lattice.
findings.fix: Replace the stale none explanation and add a scoped overlap/consumer request for coding Layers5–6 and QSeries QM.6, citing the exact pending gap and its status. Record that the Golay/Construction-A exports are reusable inputs while the actual rootless rank-24 construction, rational-to-real comparison if needed, and lattice-VOA/Monster constructions remain outside coding and need explicit owners. Preserve the unresolved intermediate Leech step and route an ownership request to the maintainer under PROTOCOL§15; do not expand the completed IntegralLattices roadmap or call plain P_2(G24) the Leech lattice. Add a directed prerequisite only after the consumer construction route and comparison contract are established; do not treat an unreviewed gap as an accepted completed supplier.
